semantics.rust_signature: fn compile_exact_native<Model>(model: Model, policy: NativeCompilePolicy, capabilities: Option<&BackendCapabilityMatrix>, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<NativeCompiledModel<Model>, NativeCompileError>
semantics.mutation_rule: wraps the native model without mutating it
semantics.alias_rule: owns the supplied model and exposes invocation only through the checked wrapper
semantics.dtype_rule: execution dtype remains owned by the native runtime backend
semantics.device_rule: native graph policy needs no device claim; CUDA-graphs requires a certified CUDA or ROCm capability matrix with native device properties; unsupported or uncertified backends fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: does not alter model arithmetic; the observed skip_torch_compile_dict source guard maps to a typed native guard policy and options outside that observed mapping fail typed
semantics.determinism: canonical serialized version-two policy SHA-256 cache token
semantics.cancellation_points: before policy sealing, capability certification, invocation, and invocation return
